item.text:
Audited the Roman transliteration in [riwayate-ume-salma.md](/home/ghayur/.local/state/kalam-codex-round2/workspaces/92609390e43446878ab08764f7cf2834/src/data/lyrics/riwayate-ume-salma.md) verse by verse. Corrected phonetic spellings, proper names, and nasal endings, and restored the fourth repetition in the Abbas and Qasim refrains. The Urdu text and metadata were preserved.

Three apparent Urdu typos still need editorial sign-off. I retained the existing Roman readings at `بابا کر سر`, `مرنی والوں`, and `غیر کے مارا`.
